assets.caption: EXHIBIT 15-49 Foam Injection into Tanks
assets.notes: Schematic diagram of a foam injection system for a storage tank. Labeled elements include FOAM BLANKET, FOAM CHAMBER, FOAM MAKER, SOURCE OF FOAM CONCENTRATE (with truck/pump), QUICK COUPLING, HOSE, LINE SLOPED, and PROVIDE DRAIN, with a dike/berm shown surrounding the tank base.
